title: loop1-reviewed-recommendation.v1
description: Human-reviewed editorial recommendation derived from Loop 1 intake understanding. Excludes retrieval scores, evaluator diagnostics, source text, and model traces.

issueNumber.description: GitHub issue number in the intake repository.

suggestedArtifact.description: Smallest adequate artifact or role (e.g. note, seed, supporting seed, section within a cluster).

themeOrCluster.description: Concise theme or cluster label. Omit when not yet assigned.

rationale.description: One or two concise sentences explaining the recommendation.

reference.description: Issue number (e.g. #21), corpus path, or short label.

relatedMaterial.description: Pointers to related backlog or published material. Omit when empty.

nextAction.description: One concrete next step for a human editor.

uncertaintyOrReviewFlag.description: Residual uncertainty, verification requirement, or editorial caution. Omit when none.

reviewedAt.description: When a human approved or superseded this record.

reviewedBy.description: Reviewer identifier. Omit for automated drafts awaiting review.

sourceLoop1Run.description: Optional path or label for the Loop 1 run that informed review. Not a model trace.
